prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A couple aged 32 and 38 walk hand in hand along a quiet snowy park path, turning toward one another with relaxed smiles. They wear ordinary wool coats and scarves in muted warm colours, with faces unobscured and hands clearly joined. Use a candid environmental photograph, soft overcast winter light, and a peaceful tree-lined background without signs. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: the woman has dark skin and neatly tied back black braids, and her male partner has olive skin, short salt-and-pepper hair and a clean-shaven face. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. Use a WIDE environmental establishing view. Both people, faces and their joined hands must fit within the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of image width, leaving snowy park context at the outer edges.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: This is a distant WIDE environmental park photograph from 8 metres away, not a close or medium paired portrait. Show both people full-length, head to boots, in the MIDDLE HALF of image WIDTH (25%-75%). Their heads and joined hands are inside the middle 40% of width. The LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER show only snowy park, with generous pavement and treetops around the couple. Natural 28mm perspective, native 16:9.

Continuous real photograph from top to bottom; no gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption area consists of normal clothing, furniture, floor or real foreground objects, with coherent physical boundaries. No part of a body fades away.
review: Wide winter park scene shows the full-length couple naturally walking and holding hands. Braids, salt-and-pepper hair, faces, joined fingers and boots are coherent. Both subjects and handhold fit well inside the central half, with generous snowy surroundings and no text. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
